name: Processor D
design_rationale: This 4-regular circulant topology connects each qubit to its one- and two-step neighbors, giving the dense all-pairs cost layer a graph diameter of 2; it is intended to reduce long routing paths relative to Processor B, whose measured L routing probe had diameter 4. The additional couplers may increase crosstalk exposure on physical hardware, which this synthetic uniform-noise model does not capture.
